label: Tanec · Krump
desc: Těžké dupnutí, chest popy a jaby, buck, švih paží, freeze v podřepu.
style_tail: , static camera, cinematic studio lighting, photorealistic, one continuous dance movement at a steady moderate tempo, highly detailed
negative: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, distorted face, extra fingers, bad anatomy, extra limbs

beats.prompt: he stomps one foot heavily on the ground and leans forward with intense energy, then holds the lean
he swings his arms in powerful chest pops and wide jabs through the air, and ends with fists at his chest
he performs one rapid buck, thrusting his chest upward and snapping his body back, and ends upright
he swings both arms as if throwing a heavy object to the side, and ends twisted toward that side
he drops into a low crouched stance, breathing heavily and staring fiercely into the lens, and stays frozen
